about: A page round a planet (r277, docs/depth-tricks.md §3): each IMAGE, SHADER and SEQUENCE layer cut in 256 vertical strips across its view, each lowered by d dx^2 / 2R, d its depth from its speed against the front's: the far layers bend more, a still one not at all. Godot draws its own strips (plax_planet.gd); jME runs core's PlanetBatch. Written by core/test-data/planet/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: planet-hiver-still-sky
scenes.about: the floor lab's Hiver set round a planet 800% of the world in radius (320 units): the trees bend least, the far peaks most; the sky band, still, is the sky and stays flat

scenes.name: planet-hiver-fogged-mirrored-flipped
scenes.about: the same set round a tighter planet (500%), every layer scrolling (the band, slowest, bends most), the far peaks mirrored above themselves, the mountain flipped on X, under a page fog of 0.02

scenes.name: planet-sequence
scenes.about: q01 (SEQUENCE strips between the hills) round a planet of 600%: each slot cut at the strips

scenes.name: planet-shaders
scenes.about: s01 (a WAVE ripple, a FOG mist band, trimmed regions) round a planet of 600%: the effects drawn on the bent strips

scenes.name: planet-repeat-xy
scenes.about: c02 (repeat X and Y, padded) round a planet of 700%, scrolling up at 30 units/s too: every row of tiles bent alike

scenes.name: planet-dolly-cross-fade
scenes.about: p01 dollied in from zoom 1 to 0.7 (each layer bent in its own view), cross-fading into p02 4 s in, over 4 s: each page round its own planet

scenes.name: planet-from-flat
scenes.about: c01 (Hiver, flat: planetRadius 0) cross-fading into p01 4 s in, over 4 s: the flat page fades out flat, the round one comes in bent

scenes.name: planet-hook
scenes.about: e01 (Hiver with an EMPTY slot, 24 wide, drawn by a hook) round a planet of 400% (r330): the hook lowers each tile as one block by planetDropAt at its middle, the images around it bent in strips
